tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so/ /

'dod dgu ma lus grub mdzad pa/ /mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo la/ /dang po nyid du phyag 'tshal te/ /mkha' 'gro yid bzhin nor bu bri/ /dang po dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed la/ a a ā zhes brjod pas stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i dbus su ro'i gdan la rdo rje phag mo nam mkha'i mdog can/ g.yas bskums pa'i rting pa bha gar gtad cing g.yon brkyangs pas gar mdzad pa/ gcer bu spyan gsum pa skra grol zhing nu ma 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis bkang ba thugs kar bsnams pa/ phag zhal mthing nag gyen la ngur zhing mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang do shal/ mi lpags dang glang chen gyi ko bas stod g.yogs shing*/ rin po che yis brgyan pa/ gru mo na kha ṭāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ phaṭa dang phain gyi sgra sgrogs shing*/ me'i 'od phung 'bar ba'i dbus na rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gros bskor bar bsam pa'i snying nang na nyi ma'i dbus su 'od kyi g.yung drung 'khyil ba'i dbus su a mthing ka shar du ha dkar po/ lhor ri ser po/ nub tu ni dmar po/ byang du sa ljang gu bsam pa las 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtse las mkha' 'gro sde lnga thon nas nam mkha'i dbyings gang ste a ha ri ni sa'i sgra sgrogs shing*/ dngos grub ci 'dod char du 'bebs par bsam pa la rlung kha sbyor du gzung ste ma yengs par bsgom la/ bzlas pa byed par 'dod na snying nang gi g.yung drung 'khyil pa g.yas bskor du 'khor bas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'khrugs pas snang srid thams cad g.yo ldeg 'phar zhing dbang du bsdu ba dang tshe dang nor 'phel ba dang*/ nad dang gdon bgegs zhi bar bsam mo/ /mkha' 'gros nam mkha' gang ba thams cad kyis sngags zlos par bsam la/ a ha ri ni sa tsitta hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥsi ti pha la hoḥ zhes bzlas pas phrin las bzhi'i dngos grub thob par bsam la/

snang ba thams cad mkha' 'gro'i rang bzhin/ sgra skad thams cad rigs sngags kyi rang sgra/ dran rtog thams cad ye shes kyi rang bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /thun rjes mkha' 'gro'i rnam pa mi bsdu bar gsal gdab la bsngo ba bya'o/ /de ltar zhag nyer gcig bsgoms pas/ dngos su nyams 'bar zhing mi nor zas gos kyi 'du ba rgya che zhing rmi lam du bud med kyi tshogs mang po rmi'o/ /sgrub dus gtor tshogs dang me tshogs cher bya'o/ /de yang me nang du mkha' 'gro bsam la zas sna dang*/ 'bru sna dang*/ dar zab dang*/ rin po che dang*/ mi dang lung pa'i ming byang bsreg la/ rtsa sngags brjod cing rig pa ngar bskyed/ bkra shis brjod do/ /gtor ma'ang bdud rtsir bsam la/ rtsa sngags bdun gyis nam phyed na dbul lo/ /de'ang sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i lta ba blo 'das chen po'i dngos grub ster dam tshig du yin min gyi the tshom mi bya/ rdo rje mkha' 'gros sgom pa 'od gsal lhun grub ster/ dam tshig tu bying rgod kyi dgras yongs su mi 'jug /padma mkha' 'gros spyod pa chags med rang grol ster zhing 'gro ba dbang du sdud/ dam tshig tu bud med bsten zhing bde stong gi don bsgom/ rin chen mkha' 'gros dngos grub rnam gnyis ster bas zhen chags dang re dogs mi bya/ khyad par du rin chen mkha' 'gros zas nor gyi char 'bebs/ dam tshig tu chags med sbyin pa'i tshogs 'gyed/ las kyi mkha' 'gros gdon bgegs bar chad sel/ dam tshig tu mi phod pa la thog brdz-is dang gdug rtsub smyon pa'i spyod pa bya'o/ /des ni myur du 'grub pa yin no/ /dge bas 'gro kun mkha' 'gro dngos grub shog /mkha' 'gro yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis bkod pa rdzogs so/ /dge'o/ / dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (10)mkha' 'gro yid bzhin nor bu/
